title: Magnetic Bead Cleaning of PCR Products
author: Alexander Eiler
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.q2udyew

steps.title: Prepare Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Calculate the required bead volume (0.8 * sample volume) and resuspend the magnetic particles by shaking the buffer bottle.

steps.title: Bind PCR Product to Beads
steps.instruction: Combine the sample and beads, then incubate to allow binding.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes

steps.title: Separate Beads from Solution
steps.instruction: Use a magnet plate to isolate the beads and remove the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Place the reaction plate onto a Magnet Plate for 2 minutes
Aspirate the supernatant from the reaction plate and discard
Keep the plate on the magnet plate until the elution step

steps.title: Wash Beads with Ethanol
steps.instruction: Perform two ethanol washes to clean the beads.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 200 μL of 70% ethanol and incubate at room temperature for at least 30 seconds
Aspirate and discard the ethanol (can be done by inverting the plate while keeping the magnetic plate on the bottom)
Repeat the ethanol wash: dispense 200 μL of 70% ethanol, incubate at room temperature for at least 30 seconds, and discard the ethanol

steps.title: Dry the Beads
steps.instruction: Remove all remaining ethanol from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Dry the beads for at least 30 minutes; optionally use a warm (30°C) heat block to speed up the process
Verify that drying is complete before proceeding

steps.title: Elute Purified Product
steps.instruction: Release the purified PCR product from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Take the plate off the magnet
Add 40 μL of elution buffer, ensuring the buffer reaches the beads
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes
Place the reaction plate onto a Magnet Plate for 1 minute to separate beads from solution
Transfer purified product to a new PCR plate or strips
